exempt.reason: Reads the current UTC date (dt.datetime.now) to age plans against .ci/config/plan-lifecycle.json, so its verdict turns red as the calendar advances while agent/plans/** and every other tracked input stay byte-identical.

Judges plan ages and allowlist entries that die on their own stated date against the wall clock (dt.datetime.now in plan_housekeeping.py), so a pass today becomes a fail later with no tracked input changed; its module also sits outside the declared paths.

Compares plan Priority against the merge-base with the target branch (D17, origin/main, GITHUB_BASE_REF) and reads dates, so its verdict depends on git history and on how far origin/main has moved, not on tracked file content alone.

Selftest of the runner drives quick-select and merge-base resolution against origin/main, reads .ci/cache state and the clock, so its verdict depends on history and untracked cache files that no tracked-input hash covers.

Judges slow/fast gate classification from the local untracked .ci/cache/gate-durations.json (measured timings), so the verdict changes when the cache changes even though every tracked file is identical.

Runs the whole pytest suite, whose tests read the clock, git history, the untracked .ci/cache toolchain and junit state, and files outside the declared paths; its verdict can move with none of the hashed inputs changing.

Runs npm ci --dry-run and npm install --package-lock-only under the pinned npm, which resolve against the live registry (including release-age windows), so a package published or yanked flips the verdict with no tracked input changed.
Runs ./run.sh setup --check against the live host (docker, node, port block) and diffs git status over the whole working tree, so its verdict tracks machine state, not declared inputs.
Executes every hook guard live with cwd at the repo root, and guards read repo, worklist and git state, so the verdict can move while the declared guard files stay byte-identical.
Runs npm ci, tsc, biome and vite build in the private/account submodule against untracked node_modules and the live npm registry, so the verdict is not a function of tracked inputs.
Checks every gate's globs against git ls-files over the whole tracked tree and runs derived: commands, so adding or deleting an unrelated file can flip it with its own inputs unchanged.
Delegates to private/renet/.ci/ci.sh quality, which runs Go with GOTOOLCHAIN=auto and can fetch toolchains and modules, so the result can move without any tracked input changing.
